data.name: Rair
data.gender_notes: Rair is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ra' which means 'sun' and 'light'. In Islamic tradition, the name Rair is believed to symbolize the radiance and brilliance of the sun, reminding us of the divine light that guides us through life. The name Rair carries the meaning “Sun, Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rair usually hope their child will grow to embody sun, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Rair is believed to have a deep spiritual significance in Islam. It is said to represent the power and might of Allah, and those who bear this name are believed to be blessed with strength, courage, and resilience in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Rair belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun, Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rair total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
